sourceOccurrences.note: C5Q9 and JGZB define the two universal properties without asserting that all countable vertex sets satisfy them. The source generalizes from weighted exponential profiles to all Bernoulli profiles; the amplification property uses k>=1 on the recorded reading of issue 52. Maximum and rooted intersections use full clusters, the root may lie outside the window, and singleton maximum/quantile values are one/two. The article exhibits the false k=0 endpoint and leaves the marked-tree partition and target proofs as obligations.
